import { api } from "./client";
import type { SimWorkRequest } from "@/types/domain";

export interface CreateWorkRequestPayload {
  schedulerOrderId: string
  workMasterId: string
  workMasterVersion: string
  scheduledEquipmentId: string
  orderedQuantity: number
  startTime: string
  endTime?: string
  priority?: number
  runId?: string
}

export interface ListWorkRequestsParameters {
  scheduledEquipmentId?: string
  material?: string
  requestState?: string
  runId?: string
}

export const workRequestsApi = {
  create: (payload: CreateWorkRequestPayload) =>
    api.post<SimWorkRequest>("/api/work-requests", payload).then(r => r.data),

  list: (parameters?: ListWorkRequestsParameters) =>
    api.get<Array<SimWorkRequest>>("/api/work-requests", { params: parameters }).then(r => r.data),

  get: (id: string) =>
    api.get<SimWorkRequest>(`/api/work-requests/${id}`).then(r => r.data),

  update: (id: string, payload: Partial<Pick<SimWorkRequest, "orderedQuantity" | "startTime" | "endTime" | "priority">>) =>
    api.patch<SimWorkRequest>(`/api/work-requests/${id}`, payload).then(r => r.data),

  cancel: (id: string) =>
    api.delete<SimWorkRequest>(`/api/work-requests/${id}`).then(r => r.data),
};
export { useSocket } from "./use-socket";

export enum RequestState {
  Forecast = "Forecast",
  Released = "Released",
  Running = "Running",
  Completed = "Completed",
  Cancelled = "Cancelled",
}

export enum RunStatus {
  IDLE = "IDLE",
  RUNNING = "RUNNING",
  PAUSED = "PAUSED",
  COMPLETED = "COMPLETED",
}

export enum StockUpdateMode {
  PerCycle = "per_cycle",
  PerOrder = "per_order",
}

export enum EventType {
  RUN_STARTED = "RUN_STARTED",
  RUN_PAUSED = "RUN_PAUSED",
  RUN_RESET = "RUN_RESET",
  WORK_REQUEST_CREATED = "WORK_REQUEST_CREATED",
  WORK_REQUEST_UPDATED = "WORK_REQUEST_UPDATED",
  WORK_REQUEST_CANCELLED = "WORK_REQUEST_CANCELLED",
  WORK_REQUEST_STARTED = "WORK_REQUEST_STARTED",
  CYCLE_COMPLETED = "CYCLE_COMPLETED",
  WORK_REQUEST_COMPLETED = "WORK_REQUEST_COMPLETED",
  WORK_REQUEST_PARTIAL = "WORK_REQUEST_PARTIAL",
  STOCK_CREDITED = "STOCK_CREDITED",
  STOCK_CONSUMED = "STOCK_CONSUMED",
  UNDERSTOCK = "UNDERSTOCK",
  OVERSTOCK = "OVERSTOCK",
  SIMULATION_PAUSED_BOM_UNRESOLVED = "SIMULATION_PAUSED_BOM_UNRESOLVED",
}

export interface SimulationRun {
  runId: string
  status: RunStatus
  startedAt?: string
  consumptionSignalId?: string
  signalLoop: boolean
  stockUpdateMode: StockUpdateMode
}

export interface SimStock {
  material: string
  description: string
  currentStock: number
  stockMin: number
  stockMax: number
  unit: string
  lastUpdatedAt: string
}

export interface SimWorkRequest {
  id: string
  schedulerOrderId: string
  runId: string
  workMasterId: string
  workMasterVersion: string
  scheduledEquipmentId: string
  material: string
  orderedQuantity: number
  remainingQuantity: number
  durationSeconds: number
  requestState: RequestState
  priority: number
  startTime: string
  endTime?: string
  createdAt: string
  targetReleaseAt: string
  releasedAt?: string
  startedAt?: string
  completedAt?: string
  estimatedCompletionAt?: string
}

export interface SimEvent {
  eventId: string
  runId: string
  simulationTime: string
  realTime: string
  type: EventType
  scheduledEquipmentId?: string
  material?: string
  orderId?: string
  quantity?: number
  stockAfter?: number
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
}

export interface ConsumptionSignal {
  signalId: string
  description: string
  unit: string
  eventCount: number
}

    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - dev*
      - master
      - main

  template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
  parameters:
    prepare_scanner_mode: CLI
    prepare_sonarExclusions: "**/node_modules/**"
    prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
      sonar.sources=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
      sonar.test.inclusions=**/*.spec.ts
      sonar.tests=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src/
      sonar.typescript.tsconfigPath=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/tsconfig.lint.json

    step_postPrepare:
      - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
        parameters:
          nodejs_version: 22.x
          run_unit_tests: false
          run_documentation_analyzer: false
          run_scss_linter: false

      - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
        parameters:
          reports:
            - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
            - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
            - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/sonar-tests.xml
            - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml
            - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/lcov.info
            - name: sonar.css.stylelint.reportPaths
              path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/stylelint.json

# base stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/httpd:2.4 AS base

COPY --from=acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/cgr/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates/*.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/

RUN update-ca-certificates

EXPOSE 3000

# build stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:22.22 AS build

ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY --from=acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/cgr/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates/*.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/

RUN update-ca-certificates

WORKDIR /app

COPY . .

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc npm ci --include=optional \
    && npm run build:meta-env-bin \
    && npm run build

FROM base AS runtime

COPY --from=build /app/web-server-config/httpd.conf /usr/local/apache2/conf/httpd.conf

COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/local/apache2/htdocs/

COPY --from=build /app/web-server-config/.htaccess /usr/local/apache2/htdocs/.htaccess

COPY --from=build /app/import-meta-env /app/

COPY --from=build /app/.env.dist /app/.env.dist

COPY --from=build /app/start.sh /app/start.sh

RUN adduser --system --no-create-home --ingroup root httpd \
  && chown -R httpd:root /usr/local/apache2 \
  && chown -R httpd:root /app \
  && chmod +x /app/start.sh

USER httpd

CMD ["/app/start.sh"]

openapi: 3.1.0

info:
  title: Chronos Simulator — Scheduler Interface
  version: "0.5"
  description: |
    REST/JSON interface exposed by the Chronos simulator to the scheduler under test.
    This is the only API the scheduler interacts with; it mirrors the MES X.0 production
    interface so that the only change required on the scheduler side is the target hostname.

    All endpoints are `application/json`. No authentication is enforced on this interface —
    PingFederate session enforcement is handled upstream by the app-proxy.

servers:
  - url: https://mesx-qua.app.corp/chronos-be
    description: QUA environment
  - url: https://mesx-dev.app.corp/chronos-be
    description: DEV environment

security:
  - bearerAuth: []

tags:
  - name: WorkRequests
    description: |
      Create, update, cancel, and poll WorkRequests.
      The scheduler drives the Forecast → Cancelled transition;
      the simulator's execution engine drives all other lifecycle transitions.
  - name: Inventory
    description: |
      Single stock/inventory endpoint — SAP OData v2 ActualStock feed (`ZPP_STOCKMVT_SRV`).
      Used by both the scheduler and the UI. Mirrors the production SAP endpoint so the
      scheduler requires no code change to switch between SAP and the Chronos simulator.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reusable components
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
components:

  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT

  schemas:

    WorkRequestState:
      type: string
      enum: [Forecast, Released, Running, Completed, Cancelled]
      description: |
        ISA-95 `RequestStateType` values used by the simulator.
        - `Forecast`  — demand received; no execution commitment
        - `Released`  — execution committed; equipment queue entry created
        - `Running`   — first production cycle has started
        - `Completed` — all ordered quantity produced
        - `Cancelled` — cancelled by the scheduler (only from `Forecast`)

    WorkRequest:
      type: object
      description: |
        Composite simulator resource flattening the ISA-95 `WorkRequest` and the root
        `JobOrder`'s `EquipmentRequirement` into a single object for the scheduler interface.
      required:
        - id
        - schedulerOrderId
        - workMasterId
        - workMasterVersion
        - scheduledEquipmentId
        - orderedQuantity
        - remainingQuantity
        - requestState
        - priority
        - startTime
        - createdAt
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Simulator-generated identifier (ISA-95 `WorkRequest.ID`). Use this for all subsequent PATCH, DELETE, and GET calls.
          example: a1b2c3d4-0001-0000-0000-000000000000
        schedulerOrderId:
          type: string
          description: Scheduler-supplied identifier (`SchedulerOrderID`). Unique within the active run.
          example: SCH-2026-00142
        workMasterId:
          type: string
          description: Work Master ID (`JobOrder.WorkMasterID`). Identifies the work template to execute.
          example: b7e2a1f0-0010-0000-0000-000000000000
        workMasterVersion:
          type: string
          description: Work Master version (`JobOrder.WorkMasterVersion`). Identifies the specific published version of the Work Master.
          example: "1"
        scheduledEquipmentId:
          type: string
          description: Target equipment (`JobOrder.EquipmentRequirement.EquipmentID`). Must be a valid option in the WorkMaster's EquipmentSpecification.
          example: c3d4e5f6-0020-0000-0000-000000000000
        orderedQuantity:
          type: number
          description: Total quantity to produce (`OrderedQuantity`).
          example: 200
        remainingQuantity:
          type: number
          description: Quantity still to produce (`RemainingQuantity`). Decremented after each equipment cycle.
          example: 85
        requestState:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/WorkRequestState"
        priority:
          type: number
          description: Execution priority within the equipment queue (ascending — lower value = higher priority).
          example: 1
        startTime:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Requested bottleneck start time (simulation time). Used to derive queue priority and `targetReleaseAt`.
          example: "2026-03-24T08:00:00Z"
        endTime:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
          description: Requested end time. Stored for schedule adherence metrics.
          example: "2026-03-24T09:00:00Z"
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Wall-clock creation timestamp.
          example: "2026-03-24T07:55:00Z"
        targetReleaseAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
          description: |
            Simulation time at which the release job will transition this request to `Released`.
            Computed as `startTime - Equipment.leadTimeBeforeBottleneck`.
          example: "2026-03-24T07:45:00Z"
        releasedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
          description: Simulation time the request was actually transitioned to `Released`.
          example: "2026-03-24T07:45:00Z"
        startedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
          description: Simulation time production began (first equipment cycle started).
          example: "2026-03-24T08:05:00Z"
        completedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
          description: Simulation time the request reached a terminal state (`Completed` or `Cancelled`).
          example: null
        estimatedCompletionAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
          description: |
            Recomputed after each cycle while `Running`:
            `simulationNow + (remainingQuantity / piecesPerCycle) x cycleTimeSeconds`.
            Jitter is not factored in.
          example: "2026-03-24T08:47:00Z"

    ActualStockMetadata:
      type: object
      description: OData `__metadata` envelope present on every ActualStock entry.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: OData entity key URI fragment.
          example: "ActualStockSet(Plant='1146',SLocation='PR10',Material='1213010XSWI')"
        uri:
          type: string
          description: Canonical OData entity URI.
          example: "ActualStockSet(Plant='1146',SLocation='PR10',Material='1213010XSWI')"
        type:
          type: string
          description: OData entity type.
          example: ZPP_STOCKMVT_SRV.ActualStock

    ActualStockEntry:
      type: object
      description: One row from the SAP `ActualStockSet` entity set.
      required:
        - __metadata
        - Plant
        - SLocation
        - Material
        - Mininmum
        - Maximum
        - Actual
        - StockBySL
      properties:
        __metadata:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ActualStockMetadata"
        Plant:
          type: string
          description: SAP plant code.
          example: "1146"
        SLocation:
          type: string
          description: Storage location code.
          example: PR10
        Material:
          type: string
          description: SAP material number.
          example: 1213010XSWI
        Mininmum:
          type: string
          description: |
            Minimum stock level (SAP spelling preserved — note the double 'n').
            Returned as a decimal string with three fractional digits.
          example: "0.000"
        Maximum:
          type: string
          description: Maximum stock level. Decimal string with three fractional digits.
          example: "500.000"
        Actual:
          type: string
          description: Current actual stock. Decimal string with three fractional digits.
          example: "8979.000"
        StockBySL:
          type: string
          description: Aggregated stock-by-storage-location value (may be empty string).
          example: ""

    ActualStockResponse:
      type: object
      description: OData v2 collection envelope wrapping the ActualStock result set.
      required:
        - d
      properties:
        d:
          type: object
          required:
            - results
          properties:
            results:
              type: array
              maxItems: 10000
              items:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ActualStockEntry"

    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      required:
        - error
        - message
      properties:
        error:
          type: string
          description: Machine-readable error code.
        message:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable explanation.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
paths:

  # ── WorkRequests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /work-requests:

    post:
      operationId: createWorkRequest
      tags: [WorkRequests]
      summary: Create a WorkRequest
      description: |
        The scheduler pushes a new demand unit in `Forecast` state.
        The simulator generates its own `id` (ISA-95 `ID`) and returns it in the response.
        The scheduler must use this `id` for all subsequent PATCH, DELETE, and GET calls.

        Queue priority within the target equipment is derived from `startTime` (earlier = higher).
        If two requests share the same `startTime`, the explicit `priority` field breaks the tie;
        if that is also equal, insertion order (FIFO) applies.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required:
                - schedulerOrderId
                - workMasterId
                - workMasterVersion
                - scheduledEquipmentId
                - orderedQuantity
                - startTime
                - endTime
              properties:
                schedulerOrderId:
                  type: string
                  description: Scheduler-supplied identifier. Must be unique within the active run.
                  example: SCH-2026-00142
                workMasterId:
                  type: string
                  description: Work Master ID (`WorkMasterID`). Identifies the work template. Must exist in master data.
                  example: b7e2a1f0-0010-0000-0000-000000000000
                workMasterVersion:
                  type: string
                  description: Work Master version (`WorkMasterVersion`). Must match a published version of the Work Master.
                  example: "1"
                scheduledEquipmentId:
                  type: string
                  description: Target equipment (`EquipmentRequirement.EquipmentID`). Must be a valid option in the WorkMaster's EquipmentSpecification.
                  example: c3d4e5f6-0020-0000-0000-000000000000
                orderedQuantity:
                  type: number
                  description: Total quantity to produce. Must be > 0.
                  example: 40
                startTime:
                  type: string
                  format: date-time
                  description: Requested bottleneck start time. Used to derive queue priority and `targetReleaseAt`.
                  example: "2025-09-03T15:15:00Z"
                endTime:
                  type: string
                  format: date-time
                  description: Requested end time. Stored for schedule adherence metrics.
                  example: "2025-09-03T16:20:00Z"
                priority:
                  type: number
                  description: Explicit priority override. If absent, derived from `startTime`.
                  example: 1
      responses:
        "201":
          description: WorkRequest created in `Forecast` state.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/WorkRequest"
        "400":
          description: Validation error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                unknownWorkMaster:
                  summary: Work Master not found
                  value:
                    error: UNKNOWN_WORK_MASTER
                    message: "workMasterId 'ffffffff-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' version '1' not found in master data."
                unknownEquipment:
                  summary: Equipment not in WorkMaster EquipmentSpecification
                  value:
                    error: UNKNOWN_EQUIPMENT
                    message: "scheduledEquipmentId 'eeeeeeee-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' is not a valid equipment option for Work Master 'b7e2a1f0-0010-0000-0000-000000000000'."
                duplicateId:
                  summary: Duplicate schedulerOrderId
                  value:
                    error: DUPLICATE_ID
                    message: "schedulerOrderId 'SCH-2026-00142' already exists in this run."
                invalidQuantity:
                  summary: Non-positive quantity
                  value:
                    error: INVALID_QUANTITY
                    message: "orderedQuantity must be greater than 0."

    get:
      operationId: listWorkRequests
      tags: [WorkRequests]
      summary: List WorkRequests
      description: |
        Returns all WorkRequests for the active run, optionally filtered.
        The scheduler uses this to poll execution progress — particularly
        `remainingQuantity` and `requestState` — to determine when to send
        the next batch of demand.
      parameters:
        - name: scheduledEquipmentId
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
          description: Filter by equipment.
          example: c3d4e5f6-0020-0000-0000-000000000000
        - name: workMasterId
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
          description: Filter by Work Master ID.
          example: b7e2a1f0-0010-0000-0000-000000000000
        - name: workMasterVersion
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
          description: Filter by Work Master version. Requires `workMasterId`.
          example: "1"
        - name: requestState
          in: query
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/WorkRequestState"
          description: Filter by lifecycle state.
        - name: runId
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
          description: Filter by simulation run. Defaults to the active run.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Array of WorkRequest objects matching the filter.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                maxItems: 10000
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/WorkRequest"

  /work-requests/{workRequestId}:

    parameters:
      - name: workRequestId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        description: The simulator-generated `id` returned by `POST /api/work-requests`.
        example: a1b2c3d4-0001-0000-0000-000000000000

    get:
      operationId: getWorkRequest
      tags: [WorkRequests]
      summary: Get a WorkRequest
      description: Returns the current state of a single WorkRequest.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: WorkRequest found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/WorkRequest"
        "404":
          description: WorkRequest not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              example:
                error: NOT_FOUND
                message: "WorkRequest 'a1b2c3d4-0001-0000-0000-000000000000' not found."

    patch:
      operationId: updateWorkRequest
      tags: [WorkRequests]
      summary: Update a WorkRequest
      description: |
        Update fields on a WorkRequest. All fields are optional; only provided fields are updated.

        Allowed fields by state:

        | Field | `Forecast` | `Released` / `Running` |
        |---|---|---|
        | `startTime` | ✓ | ✓ |
        | `endTime` | ✓ | ✓ |
        | `orderedQuantity` | ✓ | — |
        | `priority` | ✓ | — |

        When `startTime` is updated on a `Forecast` request, queue priority and `targetReleaseAt`
        are re-derived. On a `Released` or `Running` request only the stored date is updated
        (priority and release time are already committed).

        Returns `409` if the WorkRequest is in a terminal state (`Completed`, `Cancelled`),
        or if `orderedQuantity`/`priority` are supplied for a non-`Forecast` request.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              minProperties: 1
              properties:
                orderedQuantity:
                  type: number
                  description: Revised total quantity. Must be > 0. Only allowed in `Forecast` state.
                  example: 50
                startTime:
                  type: string
                  format: date-time
                  description: |
                    Revised bottleneck start time. In `Forecast` state also re-derives queue
                    priority and `targetReleaseAt`.
                  example: "2025-09-03T14:00:00Z"
                endTime:
                  type: string
                  format: date-time
                  description: Revised end time.
                  example: "2025-09-03T15:30:00Z"
                priority:
                  type: number
                  description: Revised explicit priority. Only allowed in `Forecast` state.
                  example: 2
      responses:
        "200":
          description: WorkRequest updated successfully.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/WorkRequest"
        "404":
          description: WorkRequest not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "409":
          description: |
            Update not allowed. Either the WorkRequest is in a terminal state, or a
            `Forecast`-only field was supplied for a non-`Forecast` request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                terminalState:
                  summary: Already completed or cancelled
                  value:
                    error: TERMINAL_STATE
                    message: "WorkRequest 'a1b2c3d4-0001-0000-0000-000000000000' is Completed and cannot be modified."
                forecastOnlyField:
                  summary: Quantity/priority update on a released request
                  value:
                    error: ALREADY_RELEASED
                    message: "WorkRequest 'a1b2c3d4-0001-0000-0000-000000000000' is Released: only startTime and endTime can be updated."

    delete:
      operationId: cancelWorkRequest
      tags: [WorkRequests]
      summary: Cancel a WorkRequest
      description: |
        Cancels a `Forecast` WorkRequest, transitioning it to `Cancelled`.

        The scheduler may only cancel `Forecast` WorkRequests. Attempting to cancel a
        `Released` or `Running` request returns `409` — those states are owned by the
        execution engine and cannot be cancelled directly by the scheduler.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "WorkRequest cancelled. Returns the updated object with `requestState: Cancelled`."
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/WorkRequest"
        "404":
          description: WorkRequest not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "409":
          description: WorkRequest is not in a cancellable state.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                alreadyReleased:
                  summary: Cannot cancel a Released or Running request
                  value:
                    error: ALREADY_RELEASED
                    message: "WorkRequest 'a1b2c3d4-0001-0000-0000-000000000000' is Released and cannot be cancelled directly. It must be unreleased first."
                terminalState:
                  summary: Already in a terminal state
                  value:
                    error: TERMINAL_STATE
                    message: "WorkRequest 'a1b2c3d4-0001-0000-0000-000000000000' is already Completed."

  # ── Inventory (SAP OData mirror) ──────────────────────────────────────────

  /sap/stockmovement/v1/ActualStockSet:

    get:
      operationId: getActualStock
      tags: [Inventory]
      summary: Query actual stock levels (SAP OData v2 mirror)
      description: |
        Returns current stock levels in the SAP OData v2 envelope format used by
        `ZPP_STOCKMVT_SRV`. The scheduler sends an OData `$filter` expression exactly
        as it would to production SAP; the Chronos simulator parses and applies it.

        Supported filter operators: `eq`, `or` (on `Material`), `and`.
        Supported filter fields: `Plant`, `Material`, `SLocation`.

        **Example request**
        ```
        GET /api/sap/stockmovement/v1/ActualStockSet
          ?$filter=Plant eq '1146' and (Material eq '1213010XSWI' or Material eq '1213013XSWI' or Material eq '1213010XSFI') and SLocation eq 'PR10'
        ```
      parameters:
        - name: $filter
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
          description: |
            OData v2 `$filter` expression. Supports `eq`, `and`, and `or` on
            `Plant`, `Material`, and `SLocation`.
          example: "Plant eq '1146' and (Material eq '1213010XSWI' or Material eq '1213013XSWI') and SLocation eq 'PR10'"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OData v2 collection result. `d.results` may be empty if no stock matches the filter.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ActualStockResponse"
              example:
                d:
                  results:
                    - __metadata:
                        id: "ActualStockSet(Plant='1146',SLocation='PR10',Material='1213010XSWI')"
                        uri: "ActualStockSet(Plant='1146',SLocation='PR10',Material='1213010XSWI')"
                        type: ZPP_STOCKMVT_SRV.ActualStock
                      Plant: "1146"
                      SLocation: PR10
                      Material: 1213010XSWI
                      Mininmum: "0.000"
                      Maximum: "0.000"
                      Actual: "120.000"
                      StockBySL: ""
                    - __metadata:
                        id: "ActualStockSet(Plant='1146',SLocation='PR10',Material='1213013XSWI')"
                        uri: "ActualStockSet(Plant='1146',SLocation='PR10',Material='1213013XSWI')"
                        type: ZPP_STOCKMVT_SRV.ActualStock
                      Plant: "1146"
                      SLocation: PR10
                      Material: 1213013XSWI
                      Mininmum: "0.000"
                      Maximum: "0.000"
                      Actual: "0.000"
                      StockBySL: ""
        "400":
          description: Malformed `$filter` expression.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              example:
                error: INVALID_FILTER
                message: "Unable to parse $filter expression. Supported fields: Plant, Material, SLocation."
